summary.intent: Revert web app changes from PR #461 so only the desktop DEVNET auth fix remains, and clean up the release-please config to reflect that only the desktop package is being bumped.
summary.outcome: Successfully reverted core-kit.ts to MAINNET for production, kept the desktop auth.ts DEVNET fix, and removed the spurious apps/web version bump (0.40.0→0.41.0) from release-please-config.json while preserving the desktop bump (0.39.0→0.40.0).

repo: A CI bot automatically commits 'chore(release): set release targets' to bump versions in release-please-config.json when PRs are updated — this needs manual correction if the PR scope changes.
The repo uses release-please with per-package version targets configured in release-please-config.json for apps/web and apps/desktop independently.
core-kit.ts controls the network target (MAINNET/DEVNET) and is shared; desktop auth.ts has a separate DEVNET override that is intentionally kept.

code.finding: Contains per-package release targets; apps/web entry was spuriously added by CI bot and needed removal after web changes were reverted.

workflow: After reverting changes that triggered a CI release-please bot commit, manually audit release-please-config.json to remove any package bumps that no longer apply.
When a PR's scope narrows (e.g., web changes reverted), check for bot-generated commits that may have added stale metadata.

friction: CI bot automatically added an apps/web version bump to release-please-config.json that had to be manually identified and reverted after the web changes were rolled back.
